decisions.reason: With its own dedicated page, the plug-in product is visibly part of con terra's core GIS offering and is cheap to maintain, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The digital twin service is only mentioned and its results are still uncertain, but it is a strategic growth field, and a medium firm's slack lets management carry it for another year before judging it against aspirations.
The authentication delegation service overlaps with the new identity service and may later be merged into it, but as low-cost infrastructure it is unlikely to be withdrawn within the year.
The open GIS framework underpins the firm's established project business and partner ecosystem, so dropping it would hurt core performance rather than free useful resources.
The firm actively promoted the identity service at launch as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications, which signals a commitment and early results judged satisfactory enough to keep it.
